ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of fraud and misuse of federal funds in Minnesota's Medicaid program
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the role of Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
Did Walz and Ellison enable or cover up the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on the actions of high-ranking officials
